title: Daily spending limit
requirements:
## R1 · ubiquitous · risk: money
The daily spending limit SHALL count payments made since 00:00 UTC of the current day, wherever the server runs.

## R2 · unwanted · risk: money
IF a payment would take the day's total over the limit THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse it.
claim: within_daily_limit() added in limits/daily.py with tests for under, at and over the limit. Tests pass.
